---
title: "Read a CSV file into a typed table"
---

Read [`readings.csv`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phpstats/phibble/main/docs/data/readings.csv)
into a `DataFrame`, with one column's type declared and the rest guessed:

```text
date,station,temp_c,rain_mm,wind_kmh,windy
2024-03-01,north,7.5,0.0,12,FALSE
2024-03-01,south,9.1,1.2,31,TRUE
2024-03-02,north,6.8,NA,18,FALSE
2024-03-02,south,8.4,3.5,35,TRUE
2024-03-03,north,10.2,0.0,9,FALSE
2024-03-03,south,11.0,0.4,22,FALSE
```

{{< include _read-a-csv.md >}}

- Each column's type is guessed from its values, as readr's `read_csv()`
  guesses it. The guess uses up to 1,000 sampled rows (`guessMax`).
- Whole numbers are read as int, where readr reads double.
- `types: ['station' => 'factor']` overrides the guess, which reads `station`
  as a string.
- `NA` and empty fields are missing values, which phibble stores as `null`.

The [runnable script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phpstats/phibble/main/docs/examples/read-a-csv.php)
loads Composer's autoloader and reads `readings.csv` from the working directory.

Reference: [Reading and writing data](../io.qmd) · [Types](../types.qmd).
